name: RoomVibe
description: RoomVibe is a mobile app that simplifies hostel bookings and accommodation management for students. It features dynamic profile management, booking history, payment methods, and more – all wrapped in a modern, mobile-friendly interface with a warm RoomVibe aesthetic.

features.profile_management: View and update your student profile, including verification status.
features.hostel_info: Access detailed information on hostels, including amenities and room options.
features.booking_history: Review your past bookings and manage upcoming reservations.
features.payment_methods: Securely manage your payment options and transactions.
features.referral_program: Invite friends and earn rewards with our referral program.
features.help_support: Easily contact support for any inquiries or issues.

how_to_use: Sign in to your RoomVibe account.
Update your personal profile details and verify your account.
Browse available hostels and check their room types, amenities, and ratings.
View your booking history and manage future reservations.
Participate in the referral program to invite friends and earn rewards.
Contact support if you need help.
